rationale: Career-boundary debut/last-game query pinned to the boundary's own season (id 9908: players whose first game was a Grand Final in 1897) parses correctly (grain player_career; boundary event=debut where=grand_final; seasonMin=seasonMax=1897) but the generic player_career season-range validator rejects it with 'A career question cannot be restricted to a season range.' The season range names when the boundary occurred not a career aggregation window; the validator conflates the two. All 598 rows share this shape.

All 180 rows cover seasons 1897-1926 for disposals (60) marks (60) and tackles (60) across finals (90) and grand finals (90). Example id 8918 ('most disposals in the 1897 Grand Final') plans correctly (player_game; disposals; single; max; season 1897; grand_final) then correctly declines coverage_unavailable with 'Disposals were not recorded before 1965.' The corpus's expected success/coverageBehaviour=full is the stale side; the application is right to decline rather than fabricate a pre-1965 stat.

team_match/H2H margin questions naming 'GWS Giants' (e.g. 'Adelaide biggest win versus GWS Giants' 'Adelaide worst loss to GWS Giants') decline with unsupported_term='gws' even though GWS Giants is a recognised club identity elsewhere in the parser/corpus identity handling. The recognised club-name text is leaking into unsupported-term detection for these margin templates. All 128 rows share this shape.

Expected player_season goal totals (e.g. 'GWS Giants most goals 1897') are answered via player_game rows summed over the single pinned season; scoreRow's own GRAIN_EQUIVALENT branch (corpus.ts) already treats this pair as semantically equivalent. All 72 rows are this one legitimate grain substitution; no parser or corpus change is needed.

Three-quarter-time comeback questions (e.g. 'Adelaide biggest three quarter time comeback') correctly decline in both expected and actual output; only the failure-reason label differs (expected unsupported_topic vs actual unsupported_term). No semantic-correctness defect. All 70 rows are this one reason-taxonomy mismatch; a later diagnostic-taxonomy cleanup may be worthwhile but is not a blocker.

player_career games/list questions with a numeric-equality zero-goal condition (e.g. 'players with 4 games and zero goals') decline with unsupported_term='zero'. The word-form 'zero' is not being bound as the numeric literal 0 for an equality condition and survives into unsupported-term detection instead. All 15 rows share this shape.
